# MiniCluster manifest for running kripke on a single AWS ARM CPU node.
# This configuration is tailored for the Flux Operator on Kubernetes.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Using an incrementing name to avoid collisions on subsequent runs.
  name: kripke-mc-1
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Specify the total number of pods in the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 as requested to run on a single node.
  size: 1

  # Total number of MPI tasks to run.
  tasks: 1

  # Ensure the job resources are not deleted after completion for inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Configure logging for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific options for the instance.
  flux:
    # Set architecture to ARM as per AWS instance requirement.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Use the ARM-compatible image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # The command to be executed by Flux.
      command: kripke
      # This container does not launch the Flux broker. It is a worker.
      launcher: false
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA network devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

# Corrected MiniCluster manifest for running kripke.
# The previous command failed due to an invalid argument.
# This version reverts to running kripke with no parameters as instructed,
# allowing the application to use its default settings with the allocated tasks.
# Metadata name is incremented to 'kripke-mc-3' to avoid collision.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: kripke-mc-3
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster will run on a single pod/node.
  size: 1
  # The number of MPI tasks remains 64.
  tasks: 64

  # Ensure the job resources are not deleted after completion for inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Configure logging for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific options for the instance.
  flux:
    # Set architecture to ARM as per AWS instance requirement.
    arch: arm
    container:
      # Use the ARM-compatible image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
    # Keep Flux option flags to control CPU affinity for each task.
    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # The command is set to run kripke with no parameters, as requested.
      command: kripke
      # This container does not launch the Flux broker.
      launcher: false
      # Keep environment variables required for EFA provider.
      environment:
        FI_EFA_FORK_SAFE: "1"
        FI_PROVIDER: efa
      # Resource requests and limits for AWS EFA network devices.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: kripke-mc-4
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster will run on a single pod/node.
  size: 1
  # The number of MPI tasks is set to 64.
  tasks: 64

  # Ensure the job resources are not deleted after completion for inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Configure logging for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific options for the instance.

    # Set architecture to ARM as per AWS instance requirement.
    arch: arm
    container:
      # Use the ARM-compatible image for the Flux sidecar container.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
    # Set cpu-affinity to bind one task per CPU for performance.
    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task

  # Define the main application container.

        FI_PROVIDER: efa

        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: kripke-mc-8
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: kripke --procs 4,4,4 --zones 48,48,48
    environment:
      FI_EFA_FORK_SAFE: '1'
      FI_PROVIDER: efa
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
    launcher: false
    resources:
      limits:
        vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: '1'
      requests:
        vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: '1'
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
    optionFlags: -o cpu-affinity=per-task
  logging:
    strict: true
  size: 1
  tasks: 64
